title: Night Music

facts.fact: 抬头：2041 年 11 月 5 日星期二，Oliver 13 岁与 35 岁并存
Oliver 连续第四晚失眠，住在 Belsize Park 的公寓；试过褪黑素、热牛奶、白噪音，戒咖啡反而头痛
facts.quote: Tonight is the fourth night of bad sleep. My flat in Belsize Park is quiet

facts.fact: 他忽然醒来时已在 Madeline Baxter 家的音乐室地板上，仰看她钢琴的底面；远处有零星烟花
facts.quote: I wake up suddenly and I am in Madeline Baxter's house, in the dark, lying on the floor of her music room, looking up at the underside of her piano.

facts.fact: 他穿的是 Madeline 那件黑色大雨衣（他自己的衣服太小，因为 Madeline 比他矮瘦）；雨衣上有她汗味与烟味
facts.quote: There's a black raincoat that I remember Madeline wearing, big and billowy; it will have to do.

facts.fact: 十三岁的自己坐在床上看手机，看的是去年八月生日晚餐的视频，视频里父母笑着念写给他的诗
facts.quote: Thirteen-year-old me is sitting up in bed.

facts.fact: 两人用中文轻声交谈；35 岁的他说自己来自 2063 年；十三岁的他说 Madeline 要他学读谱
Madeline 前一天带小 Oliver 去中餐馆；他的幸运饼干写着 Your luck has changed，她的写着 Happiness will come through hard work
facts.quote: She took me to a Chinese restaurant yesterday.

facts.fact: 35 岁的他预言：音乐会成为他的家，他最深的爱将属于一个专为他写音乐的女人，他将是她的缪斯、她的乐器
facts.quote: Music will be your home; your deepest love will be with a woman who will write music just for you. You will be her muse, her instrument.

facts.fact: 他说自己有个朋友，不在同一年龄、不在同一时空，人在美国芝加哥
Madeline 推门进来质问 Who the hell are you；他自报 Yang Qing / Oliver Thornton-Yang，说自己是 chrono-displaced person
facts.quote: "Who the hell are you?" Madeline asks. "And what are you doing in my house?"

facts.fact: 他解释父母怕 Madeline 知道他是时间旅行者就不收他当学生；他叔叔不知情
facts.quote: "My parents thought you would not accept me as a student if you knew I was a time traveler," I reply. "My uncle didn't know."

facts.fact: Madeline 说她可以教他钢琴、让他能留在英国，但不能为一个老是消失的孩子负责
facts.quote: "I don't mind attempting to teach Oliver to play the piano if it means he'll be able to stay in England, but I can't be expected to be responsible for a child who's disappearing all the time."

facts.fact: 他为这个场合练的是《哥德堡变奏曲》，也是 Madeline 最喜欢的一首
facts.quote: I've been rehearsing the Goldberg Variations for this occasion.

facts.fact: 展望：他爱上音乐；父母将死于狱中、情形至今不明，Madeline 会安慰他；他考进皇家音乐学院后仍住在她家；叔叔来访渐少直至不来
facts.quote: When my parents die in prison, under circumstances that are still unknown to me, Madeline will comfort me.

facts.fact: 巴赫受失眠的 Keyserling 伯爵委托写这套变奏，供其羽管键琴手 Johann Gottlieb Goldberg 夜里弹给他听——「夜曲」
facts.quote: Bach was commissioned to write these variations by an insomniac, Count von Keyserling, so that his harpsichordist, Johann Gottlieb Goldberg, could play for him at night when he couldn't sleep.

turning_point: 本章转折点是「Madeline 撞见成年 Oliver、得知他是时间旅行者，仍同意继续教小 Oliver 并留衣物给他」；已进清单（第 10、11、12 条）。
